name: Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx
ability: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Zenet" card. Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, while equipped with an Equip Card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 "Zenet" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Zenet-Nakhte Sphinx". (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up Normal Monster Card you control to the GY; change as many monsters your opponent controls as possible to face-down Defense Position, then you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY.

name: Cielo, the Veil of Raise Moon
ability: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon this card. If this card is in your hand: You can place 1 other card from your hand or face-up field on the bottom of the Deck; Special Summon this card. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can draw 1 card. You cannot add cards from the Main Deck to your hand the turn you activate this effect, except by drawing them. You can only use this effect of "Cielo, the Veil of Raise Moon" once per turn.

name: Trirealm Rift Darkness
ability:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) 8 cards from the top of your Deck. Gains effects based on the number of face-down banished cards.
● 10+: Cannot be destroyed by battle.
● 20+: Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it.
● 30+: Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can add 1 of your face-down banished cards to your hand.
● 40+: Skip the Draw Phase.
